gates.notes: Pinned upstream MX-Font remains the primary architecture. The new source audit confirms that the separate experimental raster model is not weight/checkpoint-compatible and the current episode dataset is not native MX-Font-ready.

Conditional project approval is documented for all 52 exact font files across 20 families. This pass independently downloaded the 20 pinned OFL 1.1 license snapshots and verified all snapshot hashes (zero mismatches). Official OFL-FAQ 1.1-update8 Q1.25/Q3.9 requires released font software based on these sources to remain OFL 1.1 with notices and RFN conditions. OFL is not an NC license; downstream commercial use is not prohibited. This is a project policy mapping, not legal advice; model-weight licensing is separate.

resource_estimate.note: This is not a measurement of the user's Windows machine.

blockers: The current handoff and trainer belong to the separate experimental ArabicMultimodalGlyphModel raster prototype, not native MX-Font. The architecture audit found no direct weight/checkpoint merge.
Native MX-Font needs same-character content images from other fonts plus audited Arabic decomposition/primitive labels; the current 1,732-episode handoff does not contain that contract.
The user's actual Windows GPU/VRAM/RAM/disk preflight has not been run.
No real training checkpoint or end-to-end resume cycle exists because training has not been started.
The model outputs raster images, not TTF/OTF fonts; vectorization, OpenType tables, GSUB/GPOS, font compilation and production QA remain future work.
The model-weight distribution license is separate from the OFL source-font manifest and remains unresolved.
SIL OFL is not a NonCommercial license; downstream commercial use of generated font software is not prohibited by OFL, subject to its terms.
Contextual shaping coverage remains 518/520 font-case pairs; two Aref Ruqaa tatweel cases are explicitly absent.
Expert visual/spelling/calligraphic validation and semantic component labels remain unapproved.
Arabeyes GPL+Font Exception binaries remain excluded from training pending explicit ML-training/model-output permission.
recommended_next_step: Do not treat the experimental handoff as a merged MX-Font model. For the original plan, the next engineering task is a native MX-Font Arabic data-contract/adapter design: construct same-character cross-font content images, define audited primitive/decomposition labels, and specify where Unicode/joining metadata enters the pinned MX-Font feature/factor pipeline. Keep the raster prototype quarantined. If the user later explicitly chooses the separate raster experiment, first run START_LOCAL_TRAINING.bat on the actual Windows computer and obtain explicit approval; no training is authorized by this report.
training_scope: Experimental image-reference raster baseline only: target Unicode cluster plus four same-font reference glyph images -> 128x128 raster. It is not native MX-Font, does not train semantic text prompts, and does not produce TTF/OTF files.
